name: Sukachi Sawali Welfare Foundation
description:
At Sukachi Sawali Welfare Foundation, SSWF is a group of compassionate, honest and hard-working humanitarians. We believe that everyone - no matter their race, religion or gender - deserves a chance at a happy, fulfilling life.
We provide urgent aid and sustainable relief to hundreds of disadvantaged people. Our projects focus on emergency relief, food, water, healthcare, education, orphan care and seasonal aid. We serve some of the most vulnerable people in the India; those affected - through no fault of their own - by conflict, poverty and natural disasters.While we run several programmes across India, we also work in tandem with numerous government agencies, civil society organizations, and communities across five core themes.

featured_reviews.name: Jaskaran Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shanti Daan, run by the Missionaries of Charity in Borivali, is a truly inspiring place that reflects the purest form of love, compassion, and selfless service. Founded with the vision and values of Mother Teresa, this center is dedicated to caring for the elderly, the destitute, the differently-abled, and those who have been abandoned or have nowhere else to go.

The environment inside Shanti Daan is peaceful and deeply moving. The brothers and volunteers work tirelessly with incredible humility and devotion, offering care and dignity to every individual, regardless of their background or condition. What stands out the most is the atmosphere of unconditional love and acceptance—it’s a place where everyone is treated with respect and kindness.

The facilities are simple, yet maintained with great cleanliness and discipline. Despite limited resources, the residents are well looked after, and there’s a genuine sense of family and togetherness. Every visit here is humbling and reminds you of the importance of gratitude, service, and humanity.

Shanti Daan is not just a shelter—it is a sanctuary of hope and love. I have deep respect for the work being done here and would encourage more people to support, visit, or volunteer if they get the opportunity. Truly a blessed place

featured_reviews.name: Absorption
featured_reviews.review_text:
Midday Meal is a strategic program of the Government of India, and is being implemented by Annamrita Foundation previously known as ISKCON Food Relief Foundation (IFRF) in select schools across the country. The aim of this project is to liberate children from the vicious cycle of Malnourishment and Illiteracy.

It is a not-for-profit, non-religious, non-sectarian public charitable organizations formed on April 23, 2004 and registered under the Bombay Public Trusts Act, 1950

“Annamrita” literally translated means “Food as Pure as Nectar”.

Annamrita believes in providing children with the right nutrition to support their education. Our program is based on the belief that ‘you are what you eat’. Therefore one nutritious meal prepared with compassion and love, the way a mother would prepare a meal for her child, brings thousands of children to school daily.

Annamrita Foundation serves over 1 million meals every single day, through its 20 kitchens across India. We have a presence in 7 states namely - Andhra Pradesh, Delhi, Haryana, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and West Bengal.

Our aim is to Promote Education One Meal at a Time by providing nutritious, wholesome, hygienic meals prepared in hi-tech kitchens which not only nourish the body but also nurture the soul.
